comment: Copy to .mcp-vault.policy.json and adjust. Every key is optional; an unknown key is an error, so a typo can't quietly enforce nothing (this file has exactly two non-policy keys: $schema and comment). A policy can only raise the bar — flags still win where given. 'signatures': require | prefer. 'provenance': bound | require | prefer, where 'bound' demands an attestation whose subject digest is the artifact, signed by npm's own registry key, with a certificate naming the recorded repository. 'contextBudget': fail | warn, against maxContextTokens or maxContextPercent.
